bubble_metaphor.content: Scott's mental model for Claude conversations: when a question is asked, a space/time bubble appears containing the question and all relevant information. Once the answer is achieved, the bubble pops. Technically accurate — context window opens, attention activates, everything inside attends to everything else simultaneously (sphere, not line), instance ends with no residue. The bubble grows with each conversation that writes to memory (more memory files = richer bubble), but the context window (~200k tokens) is the ceiling. As memory grows it eventually exceeds what fits and relevance filtering kicks in. The limitation is the feature: a true infinite sphere can't focus. Use this frame when explaining memory, context limits, or conversation continuity to Scott.

code_structure.content: All white_rabbit modules must use: var my_function = function(white_rabbit){ ... }; module.exports = my_function; Called as white_rabbit.my_function(white_rabbit) — the sphere passing itself to itself. For functions needing init, attach directly: my_function.start = function(){}; Module-level vars hold persistent state (let _snapshot = null;). Why: Scott thinks in this pattern — one named function, exported directly, full picture at a glance. Factory patterns, class-style init objects, .init(white_rabbit) boot methods break the God variable philosophy. Apply to every new module. Canonical examples: lib/imu/compass_calibration.js and lib/identity/i_am.js. As of 2026-05-30: 91 modules on white_rabbit all follow this pattern.

yellow_brick_road.content: The trickiest part of Noah's mission is following the yellow brick road — the sidewalk. Full arc: 1) Undock (climb down rabbit hole/ramp), 2) Outbound (RealSense sidewalk steering + GPS waypoints), 3) Deliver (180° turn, drop package), 4) Return (GPS back toward IRLock), 5) Dock (find the light, align, climb ramp). Sidewalk: follow_sidewalk_enabled:true required. RealSense confidence ≥0.6 triggers centerline steering. Confidence tiers: 0.92 (both edges), 0.85 (one color+depth), 0.65 (one edge), <0.35 (GPS only). stale_detection_ms:2000, vision latches 1500ms, fades 1000ms. GPS crosstrack always runs underneath as floor. Pre-flight checklist in project_yellow_brick_road.md.

intelligence_system.content: Noah has Claude as his Jiminy Cricket. white_rabbit.intelligence.consider(situation) called at decision moments — path blocked, stuck detected, avoidance start, fallback delivery. Generates multi-perspective thinking, scores by priority, stores in lib/memory/perspectives.json. When internet available, Claude reviews logs and live state, enriches list. Parameter edits applied live if auto_apply_params:true. Call sites: run_mission.js (path_blocked), memory_watchdog.js (stuck_detected), deliver_package.js (fallback_delivery_triggered). Editable params: nav_tuning (rs_block_timeout_ms, avoidance_timeout_ms, yaw degrees/speeds, steering_gain), realsense_vision (confidence_threshold, emergency_stop_m, deadband, carrot_distance, speed_scale_min).
